user.title: Connect Argon40
user.description: Enable I2C before continuing. [I2C setup instructions]({i2c_help_url}). Select your hardware. The next step briefly runs the fan at full speed, then restores it to 10%.

confirm.title: Check the fan
confirm.description: Did the fan spin during the test? I2C communication cannot confirm physical rotation. Only confirm if the fan worked.

error.i2c_unavailable: The I2C bus is unavailable or access was denied. Enable I2C, reboot the Raspberry Pi and check access to /dev/i2c-1. Use the setup instructions above.
error.fan_unavailable: No usable fan controller responded at I2C address 0x1a. Check the board connection and power, then try again.
error.gpio_unavailable: The button GPIO is unavailable or already in use. Check access to /dev/gpiochip* and stop other software that controls GPIO4.
error.fan_not_running: Do not finish setup until the fan works. Check its connection, then cancel and run the test again.

abort.already_in_progress: Argon40 setup is already in progress.

i2c_unavailable.message: Cannot open the I2C bus. Enable I2C and check access to /dev/i2c-1.

fan_unavailable.message: Cannot communicate with the fan controller at I2C address 0x1a.

gpio_unavailable.message: Cannot claim the case button GPIO. Check device permissions and other GPIO consumers.

not_configured.message: Add and enable Argon40 through Devices & services first.

communication_error.message: Unable to communicate with the Argon40 controller over I2C.
